hooks.command:
~/.claude/scripts/iterm2_notify.sh 'Stop' '✅ 任务完成
Claude Code 任务完成' 'Claude Finish' 1

~/.claude/scripts/iterm2_notify.sh 'Input' '🔔 需要您的输入
Claude 正在等待您的响应，请回到终端' 'Claude Waiting' 0
if [ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_EXIT_CODE" != "0" ] 2>/dev/null && [ -n "$CLAUDE_TOOL_EXIT_CODE" ]; then ~/.claude/scripts/iterm2_notify.sh 'Error' '❌ 命令执行失败 "退出码: $CLAUDE_TOOL_EXIT_CODE"' 'Claude Stop' 0; fi
